ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white (approx. 85-90%) against low-intensity black margins (approx. 10-15%). Extreme contrast between the central lobe surfaces and the perimeter pigmentation.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white field across both lobes. Black pigmentation is confined to a continuous band along the trailing edge and peduncle insertion. Presence of three discrete dark focal points (point-like mottling) on the interior right lobe and a vertical dark midline gradient.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 62 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 20% of the vertical fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing boundary. Irregular peaks and valleys with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels. Distinct jagged protrusions are most concentrated on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve leading to sharply tapered, upward-swept distal tips. Leading edge exhibits a smooth convex arc.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-contrast white-and-grey textured clusters (barnacle colonies) situated on the extreme distal tip and outer margin of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least three faint, parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions (rake-like markings) visible on the medial-lateral section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent circular dark lesion or 'hole' scar (approximately 15-20 pixels in diameter) located in the upper-right quadrant of the right lobe. Significant bio-fouling/barnacle growth on the right fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: A subtle but distinct grey vertical ridge-line extending from the peduncle junction toward the median notch, creating a localized pixel intensity gradient in the center of the white field.
